hooks.command: gd="$(git rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null)"; gc="$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)"; if [[ -n "$gd" && -n "$gc" && "$(cd "$gd" && pwd)" != "$(cd "$gc" && pwd)" ]]; then exit 0; fi; printf '%s\n' '{"decision":"block","reason":"Not in a worktree — call EnterWorktree first."}'

input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$cmd" | grep -Eq 'git[[:space:]]+add\b' && echo "$cmd" | grep -Eq -- '(-f\b|--force\b)' && echo "$cmd" | grep -Fq '.claude/plans'; then printf '%s\n' '{"decision":"block","reason":".claude/plans/ is local-only. Never force-add it. The plan is your scratchpad, not PR content."}'; fi

printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"Push detected. Run /post-push next — it ensures the PR exists, schedules a single recurring /babysit-pr loop, and spawns /review + /diagnose as parallel subagents. The Stop hook will block the turn if you skip /post-push."}}'

input=$(cat); echo "$input" | grep -Eq '"stop_hook_active"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*true' && exit 0; case "$PWD" in */.claude/worktrees/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; printf '%s\n' '{"decision":"block","reason":"Before stopping: any committed work without a PR? Open a draft PR. Pushed since last /post-push? Run /post-push. About to ask a low-stakes workflow question? Make the call yourself."}'
